MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 fits my Fire TV and Alexa setup while adding a screen that could let me view compatible security cameras.",
    "The SanDisk card addresses a practical need for my Canon camcorder, provided it meets the camera's card requirements; its adapter adds flexibility."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The earbuds, portable speaker, and USB hub solve needs I have not expressed; my recent purchases center on home viewing, security, and video recording.",
    "The WYZE camera would add another camera system without an immediate need, while the Blink bundle only becomes useful if I need more coverage.",
    "The Echo Dots and Show 5 fit my setup, but I would choose only the Show 8 because its larger screen is more useful to me right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest unrelated audio devices and computer accessories.",
    "My interest in Alexa and security cameras seems to have been interpreted as wanting several more devices with similar functions."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Accessories that support equipment I already own can be more useful than another standalone device, but compatibility matters before I choose them.",
    "I already have multiple cameras, so an additional camera needs to address a specific coverage gap or offer a clear reason to add another system.",
    "Several Alexa devices can appeal to me without being separate purchases; I prefer the larger display and would choose one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my home viewing and security interests but confused related devices with things I currently need."
}
